notes.title: Release next week!
notes.notes:
[b]Finally, we're about to release our game for all STEAM users.[/b]

We're glad that you enjoyed the demo - it was a good premise of what you'll be able to find in the final product. 

The last-minute change inspired by one of your comments in the game hub - SH won't be time limited to 30 days as we originally planned. With STORY MODE, you'll be able to enjoy the game as long as you want - without any pressure.
